title: Prepare complete owned disc content for native startup
goal: Extend the read-only disc inventory into an exclusive, streamed private content preparation tool; the current private directory contains only the two XEX files and cannot supply a complete game scene.
acceptance: Reuse the bounded Disc reader and supported-build manifest without changing their shared contracts; verify source ISO identity and both root executable hashes before content preparation

Preflight every relative path, extent, entry/byte budget, Windows reserved-name/normalization collision and destination ancestor; reject traversal, links/reparse redirection and pre-existing destinations without overwriting inputs

Stream all supported content to a fresh private output with bounded memory, preserve failed attempts, and publish a complete identity/tool/file-hash manifest only after verifying the prepared files and unchanged source
Keep immutable content and writable profiles distinct; no content, game bytes, keys, SDKs or private manifests enter Git
validation: Use original synthetic images for nested/empty files, malformed extents, cycles, path/Windows-name collisions, byte-budget exhaustion and redirected/pre-existing destinations
Run game-free Windows/Linux checks and parser diagnostics; use actual filesystem link/reparse cases where supported and report unavailable privilege cases explicitly

After source review, privately prepare the owner's supported Rev 1 ISO, reconcile the full inventory/file hashes and unchanged ISO hash, and verify failure cases do not overwrite existing files; no game execution claim
